technique_name: Explain to me why machine learning is better than traditional programming.
description: Machine learning is a more efficient and accurate way of solving problems as compared to traditional programming. This is because machine learning utilizes techniques such as pattern recognition, data mining, deep learning, natural language processing, and other techniques to recognize patterns and extract meaning from large amounts of data.
